Our little memories

For you, Shivani

Shivani ❤️

I don't know if a webpage can say everything that my heart wants to say,
but I wanted to try.

There are so many ordinary moments with you that became special simply
because you were there. Your smile, your voice, your little habits,
the way we laugh together — somehow all of it became a part of my life.

I know things aren't always perfect. I know there can be moments when
you feel like walking away, and I don't want to make you feel trapped
or pressured. I just want you to know what you mean to me.

I love you. Truly.

And if there is still a little space in your heart for us, I want to
choose you again and again — not just on the easy days, but on the
difficult ones too.

I don't want a perfect story.
I want our story.

So before you decide to walk away, look at these memories once more
and remember that behind every picture is a moment that meant the
world to me.

If you choose to stay, I'll be grateful.
If you need time, I'll respect that.
But if you ask me what I want...

I want you, Shivani.
I want us. ❤️

— Yours, always
Whatever happens, I hope you always remember this:
You are not just a chapter in my life.
You became one of the reasons my life feels like mine. ❤️
I love you, Shivani.
Made with love, just for you ❤️
